title: mentha longifolia var. acuminata
intro: Mentha longifolia var. acuminata, commonly known as Long-horned Horseradish Mint, is a variant of the Mentha longifolia plant, a species of mint native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Long-horned Horseradish Mint include its use in traditional medicine as a carminative, antispasmodic, and expectorant, helping to relieve symptoms of indigestion, respiratory issues, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
